history.summary: Freehold 4BR (1,260sqft) at $1,492 PSF, 430m from Kembangan MRT in D14, at a reasonable $1.88M quantum. Genuinely appealing MRT-proximate freehold family unit, but built 1993 (~33yr) and backed by only a 2-txn URA series, so value vs the $1,244 median can't be reliably judged.
history.rating_rationale: Attractive on paper — freehold, 430m to Kembangan MRT (EWL), liquid $1.88M quantum, and a usable 1,260sqft 4BR for families. But it asks $1,492 PSF vs a $1,244 median (a ~20% premium, though the 2-txn median is thin and unreliable), the building is ~33 years old, and there's no real appreciation series. Boutique-scale (Vicenta Lodge is a small development), which caps liquidity. The location strength offsets the age/premium to a balanced Neutral.
red_flags: Asking PSF ~20% above the (thin 2-txn) URA median
Only 2 URA txns — boutique/illiquid, value unverifiable
catalysts: $1.88M family-sized freehold in the liquid band
